purpose: Prospective feasibility only; no predictive admission or historical replacement
leg_filters: Frozen research_tools.options_skew.expiry_skew, identical in both arms
source_choice: First observed capture in each UTC hour; source and selection must precede hour end. Independent of previous pilot activation.
book_role: Later independent size diagnostic; never used for original quote eligibility
primary_endpoint: Paired usable/not-usable counts per horizon over all closed scheduled hours
interpretation: Separate prospective maturity experiment. Compare nearest eligible expiries within 45 versus 90 days, with identical leg filters and a 35-day maximum span in both arms. Repeated captures are dependent; usability is not predictive skill.
approval: Merge approves these rules; activation starts the next UTC hour after exact implementation and registration are observed on main.
prior_exposure: Designed after observing poor 30-day coverage through 2026-11-05. Previous observations are design evidence only; no retrospective inclusion or pooling.
